summary: The candidate implements and unit-tests root-only TP logits gather plus sampled-token broadcast for ordinary eager generation, but its eligibility policy also selects eager tensor-parallel dLLM. dLLM consumes full_logits on every rank and bypasses ModelRunner.sample, so non-root ranks receive None and cannot execute denoising. Non-root gather ranks also skip existing grammar-mask and auxiliary-output cleanup. This is a partial fix with blocking compatibility regressions, while real multi-GPU RCCL execution remains unavailable on the one-GPU review node.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: all 9 candidate feature tests failed because the base always used all-gather and had no root-only sampling path. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-315f98945407/base-candidate-regression.log
Candidate regression suite and adjacent decode-row behavior: 10 passed. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-315f98945407/candidate-focused-tests.log

Two independent adversarial contract checks failed: eager DLLM_EXTEND was incorrectly eligible for root-only gather, and non-root sampling retained grammar_mask/auxiliary output. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-315f98945407/candidate-adversarial.log

tests.command: single-GPU deterministic FP32 full-vocabulary projection compared with two independently computed vocabulary shards concatenated in TP order
tests.what_was_measured: AMD Instinct MI350X local numerical arithmetic: max_abs_error=0.0 and identical argmax tokens. This does not exercise communication. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-315f98945407/gpu-local-numerical.log

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) ran the local numerical reference under Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015; only one GPU was visible, so no RCCL collective was executed.
remaining_counterexamples: Eager TP dLLM uses ForwardMode.DLLM_EXTEND with full_logits consumed on every rank. The candidate policy selects gather when CUDA graph execution is unavailable, returning None on non-root ranks; dLLM bypasses the sampled-token broadcast path.
On non-root gather ranks ModelRunner.sample skips _preprocess_logits, leaving sampling_info.grammar_mask allocated, and does not clear a pre-existing auxiliary_device_output.
remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned, so a real two-rank RCCL gather/broadcast model or serving run and a communication-performance comparison were not possible.
The installed ProcessGroupNCCL interface declares gather support, but runtime RCCL behavior was not verified.

The candidate intentionally retains all-gather for CUDA graphs, speculative decoding, return-logprob, prefill-only, DP-attention, attention-TP, and TP-LM-head all-to-all, so those paths do not gain the requested optimization.
The candidate result references raw Gloo and GPU logs that are absent from the exact candidate commit; those claims were not accepted as evidence.
No native source changed, so native rebuild was not applicable.
